description: Use when you need a wallet balance, token balances or the ERC20 balance of an address on Base, read live from the chain. Do not use for ethereum mainnet or other chains, NFTs, transaction history or USD values. Returns JSON with the wallet balance of an address on Base: ETH and ERC20 token balances read on-chain in one block, 21 major tokens plus any you list for 0.003 USDC per call. Typical response time 1200 ms (p95). Category: Data.

includeZero.description: Also list tokens with zero balance (false when omitted)

response_format.description: concise (the default when omitted) keeps the JSON short: long fields such as base64 images or audio come back as separate image/audio content blocks and other long strings are cut with a marker; detailed returns the full JSON

tokens.description: Extra ERC20 token addresses on Base to check, e.g. ["0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000006"] (up to 20, beyond the 21 major ones)

name: blackwood_wallet_balances

next.description: Suggested next paid call in the same family (call it in a loop when the task continues)

sample.description: Free fixed sample of the whole family

service.description: Service id of the suggested next paid call

tool.description: MCP tool name of the same call

url.description: Paid route of the next call

useWhen.description: When the next call is the right one

anyOf.description: x402 PaymentRequired (returned with isError when payment is needed)

title: Wallet balances on Base
